headline: Cool mid-October on Table Rock — fall fishing bite and crisp evenings
lede: Wednesday, October 14 brings seasonable fall weather with a high near 68°F and lows in the low 50s. A mix of clouds and sun with a chance of showers — ideal for a layered lake day with indoor options nearby.

featured.title: Table Rock Lake Fall Fishing
featured.where: Main lake points and coves near Notch Lane
featured.why: Post-cold front conditions typically improve the bite. Focus on shallow-running crankbaits or jigs. Verify current USACE lake levels and generation schedule.

plan.title: Early morning fishing
plan.detail: Cooler water temps have bass and walleye active in shallower water. Try main lake points and brush piles. Light wind expected.

plan.title: Lake cruise or indoor attractions
plan.detail: Enjoy the fall colors on the water or head to air-conditioned shows and museums on the Strip if showers develop.
